content.title: Protect yourselves where you are
content.summary: A quick recall check on what to do the moment the shaking starts.

sources.label: Earthquake Country Alliance (Great ShakeOut) — Drop, Cover, and Hold On

checkin.prompt: The room starts shaking and you're inside. What do you do?

choices.label: Run outside as fast as you can
Drop onto your hands and knees, cover your head and neck, and hold on
Stay on your feet until the shaking stops

checkin.remember: Drop, cover your head and neck, and hold on until the shaking stops. If you're inside, stay and do not run outside.
checkin.fullerExplanation: Ready.gov says: if you are inside, stay and do not run outside. Drop onto your hands and knees, cover your head and neck, and hold on until the shaking stops.
